card.name: Final letter of capitalized acronyms
card.fires_on: The last letter piece completing an all-caps name or acronym, mostly the K ending the brand name ALYFTREK. Also A or F ending acronyms like MGNREGA and USPSTF.

modes.label: Brand name ending K
modes.description: The K that completes the drug brand name ALYFTREK in interaction and warning text.
modes.example: If ALYFTRE<<K>> is used, closely monitor for adverse reactions

modes.label: Other acronym endings
modes.description: The final letter of a long all-caps organization or program acronym in news or web text.
modes.example: a member of the USPST<<F>> panel and a senior investigator at Group Health

card.plain: It fires on the last letter that finishes a capitalized name, especially the drug name ALYFTREK.
